▸ Ensuring mise install
ensure_correct_mise_install

▸ Trusting mise config
mise trust --yes $APP/.mise.toml
mise trusted $APP

▸ Installing system packages
brew bundle --file=$APP/Brewfile

▸ Installing Ruby and tools
mise install --yes
